suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved without a single 'can you also' comment tacked on.
I'm thankful for the Fajr azan pulling me out of bed before my alarm even gets the chance to.
I'm grateful for a staging bug that turned out to be a typo and not three days of debugging.
I'm thankful for my mom still packing extra rice for me to bring back on Sunday nights.
I'm grateful for the LRT actually arriving on time when I'm already running late.
I'm thankful for a teammate who merged my branch without making me explain every line twice.
I'm grateful for the office pantry having decent kopi on the one day I forgot my flask.
I'm thankful for a client call that ended early because everything just worked.
I'm grateful for the breeze through the window during Maghrib, right after a day stuck indoors.
I'm thankful for a production incident that got caught by the alert, not by a customer tweet.
I'm grateful for my grandmother's voice note reminding me to eat properly, not just mamak food.
I'm thankful for a Friday where the sermon was short and the traffic after was somehow shorter.
I'm grateful for a junior dev asking a question that made me realize I didn't fully understand it either.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of still having a job when half my batch got retrenched this year.
I'm grateful for a Sunday with absolutely nothing on the sprint board and nowhere I need to be.
